newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: PDVSA shipping unit to join forces with U.S. group.
newsitem.headline: PDVSA shipping unit to join forces with U.S. group.

text.p: PDV Marina, the shipping arm of Venezuelan state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) will sign a strategic association with U.S. shipping company Maritime Overseas Corporation next year to build and operate four tankers, state news agency Venpres reported.
The tankers will cost $32 million each to build and will transport gasolines, lubricants, diesel and aviation fuel, Venpres said citing PDV Marina President John Vinei.
The new tankers form part of PDV Marina's expansion plans which will see it transport 550,000 barrels per day of crudes to the United States in 1997, Vinei said.
